insights.summary: Q4 FY26 revenue rose 186% to ₹95.6 Cr with EBITDA of ₹58 Cr (60.7%) and a small profit of ₹6.4 Cr, as GPU utilisation reached about 80% in March and the monthly revenue run rate (MRR) hit ₹37.4 Cr. FY26 revenue grew 50% to ₹246 Cr but PAT was a ₹15.6 Cr loss because of GPU depreciation. Management gave no revenue or MRR guidance; the first 1,024 NVIDIA B200 cluster was due in mid-May with a second within months, and E2E is exploring asset-light GPU financing including an MoU with L&T.

what_changed.text: B200 cluster go-live slipped to mid-May on supply-chain delays
At least ~6,000 GPUs targeted by end of FY27
Exploring private credit and asset-light partnerships (L&T MoU)

tone.label: confident
tone.quote:
We gave a certain guidance in terms of where we would be by the end of this quarter a
couple of quarters back. I think we have more or less met and exceeded that target

analyst_questions.answer: Declined; the market changes week to week, so judge quarter by quarter.
Government (India AI Mission) business no more than 35-40% of the quarter.
No pressure; prices inching up; GPUs usable for 7-8 years.

red_flags.text: FY26 net loss of ₹15.6 Cr as depreciation (₹51 Cr in Q4) outran revenue.
No revenue, MRR or capex guidance, so management can't be held to targets.
Revenue was lumpy in recent quarters; small GPU base.
B200 cluster was procured earlier but delayed.

watch_next: B200 cluster live and on revenue in Q1
Utilisation and MRR after new capacity
